section_schema: Actual atlas uses one combined Astronomy/Astrology category. The pre-search protocol anticipated possible separate Astronomy and Astrology values; none exist. Execution preserves the existing combined category, with no post hoc split.
coverage: 18 reading codes are alternate partial records and editorial traditions, not 18 complete independent transcriptions. F has only329 readable Astronomy/Astrology tokens and no g tokens in the entire atlas; F absence is not a negative glyph finding.
botanical_schema: Atlas Botanical is a section label, not a guarantee of a plant drawing: f57v is a diagram. Its daro and otodarod hits are separately flagged and excluded from claims about illustrated herbal pages.
